_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. byborre.com declares a Tailwind custom-property layer in its Nuxt bundle (raw/css-vars.json) — the --color-primary-* green ramp and --color-gray-DEFAULT, held as rgb() channel triplets — plus measured computed styles (raw/components-computed.json) for the ink/cream neutrals, the yellow hover accent, Helvetica Neue, the 10px control radius and the 0.15s/0.3s motion. The 'dark' set is the #1b1b1b ink surfaces the light page paints (footer, marquee, hero media), not a user-selectable theme.
